title: Polihali strike-linked protests or public meetings (occurrence and threshold unresolved)
location: Polihali Dam / Mokhotlong is the context for the strike; actual protest or meeting location unknown
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; Amnesty’s retrospective report does not quantify any protest or meeting.

start_date.summary: Amnesty locates strike-linked protests/public meetings in September but gives no day.

location.summary: No gathering location specified; Polihali is only the worker/strike context.

demands.summary: Amnesty reports demands for higher wages and better working conditions.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No crowd/meeting size or simultaneity evidence.

state_response.summary: Report says authorization was restricted but gives no event-specific accommodation, arrest, dispersal, beating, shooting or killing evidence.

eligibility.summary: Retrospective report says protest/public meetings were connected to strike action, but does not establish that a qualifying gathering proceeded, reached 50, or addressed the Lesotho state rather than employer.

notes: Keep separate from the wage strike itself and from the AfDB complaint. The report gives an assembly-related lead but not occurrence, threshold, exact place or state-target proof; no candidate is verified.
